title: Broker-Dealer Entity
description: Schema describing a registered broker-dealer entity as defined by FINRA and SEC regulations, representing firms like those assembled under RCS Capital / Cetera Financial Group.

crdNumber.description: FINRA Central Registration Depository (CRD) number for the firm.

legalName.description: Legal registered name of the broker-dealer.

tradingName.description: DBA (doing business as) name, if different from legal name.

secRegistrationNumber.description: SEC registration number for the broker-dealer.

registeredStates.description: US states in which the firm is registered to conduct business.

parentCompany.description: Name of the parent holding company.

advisorCount.description: Number of registered representatives affiliated with this firm.

assetsUnderAdministration.description: Total assets under administration in USD.
